title: Optimize CPU translation and synchronization from profiles
goal: Apply register locality, ThinLTO, PGO and targeted synchronization improvements only with differential evidence.
acceptance: Retain conservative ABI path; verify callbacks, nonlocal exits, atomics and indirect targets
Use representative all-mode training data and compare speed, binary size, build time and correctness
validation: Differential synthetic instruction suites and all-mode regressions
Repeated A/B runs with matched compiler/hardware settings
